title.zh: 元音空间 · 共振峰 F1 与 F2
title.en: Vowel space · formants F1 and F2

description.zh: 元音的音高由基频 F0 定，是哪个元音则由声道放大的几个频率峰（共振峰）定：只用前两个 F1、F2，就能把元音画成平面上的点；男人、女人、孩子的点整体错开，要先按说话人整体缩放才能认对。
description.en: A vowel’s pitch is set by the fundamental F0, but which vowel it is depends on the frequency peaks the vocal tract amplifies (formants): the first two, F1 and F2, place each vowel as a point on a plane; men’s, women’s and children’s points are shifted as a whole, so they must be rescaled by speaker before vowels can be recognised.

zh: 为什么男女声说同一个元音频率不同
en: why do men and women’s vowels differ in frequency

label.zh: 元音的频谱：谐波加包络峰
label.en: A vowel’s spectrum: harmonics under envelope peaks

reason.zh: 浊音的波形每秒重复 F0 次，频谱上是 F0、2F0、3F0…… 一排谐波；共振峰是这些谐波上方包络的峰，要在频谱里才看得见。
reason.en: A voiced sound repeats F0 times a second, giving a row of harmonics at F0, 2F0, 3F0 … in its spectrum; formants are peaks in the envelope over those harmonics, visible only in the spectrum.

label.en: The vocal tract is a set of resonators

reason.zh: 从喉到唇的声道像共鸣腔，把某些频率附近的谐波放大；舌头和嘴唇改变腔的形状，共振频率跟着移动，元音就变了。
reason.en: The tract from larynx to lips acts like a resonator, amplifying harmonics near certain frequencies; tongue and lips change its shape, the resonant frequencies move, and the vowel changes.

label.zh: 对数刻度让缩放变成平移
label.en: A log scale turns rescaling into shifting

reason.zh: 元音图两轴用对数刻度，相同距离代表相同倍数；所以按说话人整体乘一个比例来归一化，在图上就是把整圈平移。
reason.en: Both axes of the vowel plot are logarithmic, so equal distances mean equal ratios; normalising a speaker by multiplying by one factor is then just shifting the whole loop.
